hypothesis: The same frozen GradientBoostingClassifier and exactly ten original features may produce a useful high-confidence subset when trades are admitted only for p_up >= 0.80 or p_up <= 0.20.

dataset.rule: Abort with INSUFFICIENT_DATA if SHA-256, row count, or time range differs. Do not silently update this registration.

feature_boundary: Exactly the original ten frozen features. No new features, no model changes, and no threshold tuning after results.
target: Direction of the next contiguous five-minute close-to-close return. Skip samples crossing a missing/non-five-minute bar.

validation.purge_embargo: At least 30 minutes between train and test boundaries.

verdict_rules.EDGE_CONFIRMED: At least 3 valid folds, at least 50 test-set signals with p_up >= 0.80, and aggregate hit_rate_after_cost for the p_up >= 0.80 bucket greater than 0.60.
verdict_rules.EDGE_REJECTED: At least 50 p_up >= 0.80 test-set signals exist and their aggregate hit_rate_after_cost is at or below 0.60.
verdict_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Pinned dataset provenance mismatch, fewer than 3 valid folds, fewer than 50 p_up >= 0.80 test-set signals, or required evaluation data missing.

integrity_rule: This separate registration must be committed before running the filter-80 evaluation. The original registration file remains unchanged.
